import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Disable progress bars globally
os.environ["TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM"] = "false"

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Train Insult distribution: {train_df['Insult'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Combine comments column
train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].fillna("")
test_df["Comment"] = test_df["Comment"].fillna("")


# Clean and preprocess comments
def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        # Remove unicode escape sequences
        text = text.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore").decode("utf-8")
        # Clean newlines
        text = text.replace("\n", " ")
        text = text.replace("\t", " ")
        return text.strip()
    return str(text).strip()


print("Preprocessing text...")
train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["Comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Create validation split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["Comment"].values,
    train_df["Insult"].values,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["Insult"],
)

# Create TF-IDF vectorizers
print("Creating TF-IDF features...")

# Character n-grams (existing features)
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=50000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Word n-grams (new features to add)
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_features=20000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Transform training and validation data
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)

X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)

# Concatenate feature matrices horizontally
X_train_tfidf = np.hstack([X_train_char.toarray(), X_train_word.toarray()])
X_val_tfidf = np.hstack([X_val_char.toarray(), X_val_word.toarray()])

# Train Logistic Regression model
print("Training Logistic Regression...")
lr_model = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0, max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", class_weight="balanced", n_jobs=-1
)
lr_model.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train)
lr_preds = lr_model.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)[:, 1]

# Train Gradient Boosting model
print("Training Gradient Boosting...")
gb_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=100, max_depth=3, learning_rate=0.1, subsample=0.8, min_samples_leaf=20
)
gb_model.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train)
gb_preds = gb_model.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)[:, 1]

# Ensemble predictions (average)
val_preds = (lr_preds + gb_preds) / 2

val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Retrain on full training data
print("Retraining on full training data...")
X_train_full = train_df["Comment"].values
X_test = test_df["Comment"].values

X_train_full_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_train_full)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test)

X_train_full_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_train_full)
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test)

X_train_full_tfidf = np.hstack(
    [X_train_full_char.toarray(), X_train_full_word.toarray()]
)
X_test_tfidf = np.hstack([X_test_char.toarray(), X_test_word.toarray()])

full_lr_model = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0, max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", class_weight="balanced", n_jobs=-1
)
full_lr_model.fit(X_train_full_tfidf, train_df["Insult"].values)
full_lr_preds = full_lr_model.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]

full_gb_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=100, max_depth=3, learning_rate=0.1, subsample=0.8, min_samples_leaf=20
)
full_gb_model.fit(X_train_full_tfidf, train_df["Insult"].values)
full_gb_preds = full_gb_model.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]

# Ensemble predictions
test_preds = (full_lr_preds + full_gb_preds) / 2

# Save submission
print("Saving submission...")
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Comment": test_df["Comment"], "Insult": test_preds})
submission_df = submission_df.sort_values("Comment").reset_index(drop=True)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"\n=== FINAL RESULTS ===")
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")
print(f"Test predictions: {len(test_preds)} rows")
print(f"Submission saved to: ./submission/submission.csv")

print(f"\nInsult probability distribution:")
print(f"  Mean: {test_preds.mean():.4f}")
print(f"  Std: {test_preds.std():.4f}")
print(f"  Min: {test_preds.min():.4f}")
print(f"  Max: {test_preds.max():.4f}")
